name: A Lone Girl's Reminiscence
source:
"This place is devoid of days or nights, of anything but me and my thoughts. No matter how far I walk, there’s only an endless white nothingness."

A girl finds herself lost in an infinite, all-encompassing void. All she can do is walk forward in the hope of finding something other than herself.

A short visual novel in which you listen to a lonely girl reflect on her life.

[Edited from [url=https://misamxsa.itch.io/a-lone-girls-reminiscence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“这里没有白天，没有黑夜，没有任何东西，只有我和我的思想。无论我走多远，只有无尽的白色虚无。”

一个女孩发现自己迷失在无限的、包罗万象的空虚之中。她所能做的就是向前走，希望能找到除了自己之外的东西。

一部简短的视觉小说，你可以在其中聆听一个孤独的女孩反思她的生活。

[编辑自[url=https://misamxsa.itch.io/a-lone-girls-reminiscence]itch.io[/url]]
